statement.excerpt: In the midterms, AI will be an election issue for first time.
statement.document_title: Six (or seven) predictions for AI 2026 from a Generative AI realist

from_speaker: AI will be an election issue
our_interpretation: The midterms means the 2026 US congressional election campaign, through November 3, 2026.
An election issue means AI policy or its effects are a substantive subject of campaign commitments or debate. Use of AI to produce campaign material alone does not qualify.
First time refers to earlier US federal elections generally. Marcus did not expressly restrict the comparison to earlier midterms.
The sentence contains two assessable components: AI becoming a 2026 campaign issue and this being unprecedented. Neither requires AI to be voters' leading concern.
criteria.support_condition: Campaign records establish substantive discussion of AI policy in 2026, and examination of earlier elections finds no comparable precedent.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented earlier federal election campaign already included substantive AI policy commitments, contradicting the first-time component; alternatively, completed 2026 campaign records establish that AI did not become an election issue.
